node.title: Uniform corank-three projective-basis cap
node.closure: requires structure beyond support-local transversality at t>=1
node.statement: Prove or refute that every official rank-eleven kernel corank-three canonical-basis chart has at most 983902549 records. This value is proved only at complete shortening; the current valid integer-gap envelope gives 3935391907 at K'=377674.
